progress.question: What happens to my words and progress when I change plans?
progress.answer: Your words and progress stay in your account. Available learning tools depend on your current plan.

billing.question: When am I charged?
billing.answer: Subscriptions are billed in advance for the selected period and renew automatically until canceled. Review the final total in Paddle before confirming.

expiry.question: Do tutor minutes expire?
expiry.answer: Purchased packs are valid for one year. Included tutor minutes are granted as a bank for the subscription billing period.

refund.question: Can I get a refund?
refund.answer: Refund requests are handled according to our published refund policy.
